dialogs.about: 부엌 수도꼭지에서 물이 새서 할아버지와 이야기해요

lines.en: Listen. The tap is dripping again.
lines.ko: 들어 보세요. 수도꼭지가 또 똑똑 떨어져요.

lines.en: I hear it. Did it leak yesterday?
Yes, it leaked all day yesterday.
The pipe in the kitchen is old.
Can you fix it this afternoon?
lines.ko: 오늘 오후에 고쳐 줄 수 있어요?

lines.en: Sure. Is the heater working well?
Yes, but the boiler makes a sound.
I will check the thermostat too.
Thank you. The pipes freeze in winter.
Don't worry. I am going to wrap them.

dialogs.about: 관리 사무소에서 안내원에게 보일러 수리를 부탁해요

lines.en: Excuse me. Our boiler stopped this morning.
Oh, I'm sorry. Is the water cold?
Yes, very cold. No steam at all.
lines.ko: 네, 아주 차가워요. 김도 전혀 안 나요.

lines.en: Does the heater work in your bedroom?
It works, but the room is not warm.
A worker will visit at two.
Thank you. Can he check the tap too?
lines.ko: 고마워요. 수도꼭지도 봐 줄 수 있어요?

lines.en: Of course. Is it leaking or dripping?
It drips slowly. It leaked last week.
He will fix everything. Please wait, Ma'am.
lines.ko: 다 고쳐 드릴 거예요. 사모님, 조금만 기다려 주세요.
